# mtncloud_security_group (Data Source)

Looks up one security group by ID or by name, including one made in the console, with its project and every rule. A name must match exactly one group; add `project` when the same name is used in several projects. To list the groups of a project, use `mtncloud_security_groups`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Add project when the same name is used in several projects.
data "mtncloud_security_group" "web" {
  name    = "web"
  project = "web-prod"
}

output "web_ingress_rules" {
  value = [for r in data.mtncloud_security_group.web.rules : "${r.protocol}/${coalesce(r.port_range, "all")}" if r.direction == "ingress"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Security group ID. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Security group name, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.
- `project` (String) Project name (for example `web-prod`), to tell apart groups with the same name. The full platform name, with the tenant suffix, also works. Always set to the group's project, without the suffix.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `external_id` (String) Security group ID in the cloud (the external ID).
- `rules` (Attributes List) Every rule of the group, including the default egress rules, sorted by what they allow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) Remote addresses; null for any address or a group rule.
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is one of the default egress rules MTN Cloud adds.
- `description` (String) Rule name in the console.
- `direction` (String) `ingress` or `egress`.
- `id` (String) Rule ID.
- `port_range` (String) Port or range; null for all ports.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp` or `any`.
- `source_security_group_id` (String) Remote security group, for group rules.
